passage:
NovaTech Kitchen Appliances — Limited Warranty Terms

All NovaTech appliances are covered by a two-year warranty on parts and a one-year warranty on labor, beginning on the date of purchase. Customers who register their product online within 30 days of purchase receive an additional six months of labor coverage. Proof of purchase is required for all warranty claims. The warranty does not cover damage resulting from misuse, unauthorized repairs, or commercial use. Repairs must be performed at a NovaTech authorized service center. NovaTech covers shipping costs to service centers during the first 90 days only; after that period, customers are responsible for shipping their unit.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: support@novatech.com
From: Marcus Bell <m.bell@quickpost.net>
Date: November 4
Subject: Repair request — NovaTech ProBlend 700

Dear Customer Support,

I purchased a ProBlend 700 blender fourteen months ago, and last week its motor stopped working completely. I have used it only at home and have never attempted to repair it myself. I registered the product on your Web site during the week I bought it, and I still have my original receipt. Could you confirm whether the labor for this repair will be covered and let me know what costs, if any, I should expect? Please also tell me where the nearest authorized service center is located.

Sincerely,
Marcus Bell

questions.question: According to the warranty terms, what is covered for two years?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문에서 'a two-year warranty on parts and a one-year warranty on labor'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 즉 부품(parts)은 2년, 수리 인건비(labor)는 1년 보증이므로 정답은 'Replacement parts'입니다.

questions.question: What must customers do to receive extended labor coverage?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문에서 'Customers who register their product online within 30 days of purchase receive an additional six months of labor coverage'라고 했으므로, 구매 후 30일 이내에 온라인으로 제품을 등록해야 인건비 보증이 6개월 연장됩니다.

questions.question: Will the labor for Mr. Bell's repair most likely be covered?
options: No, because the warranty expired after one year
No, because he misused the blender
Yes, because he registered the product and is within 18 months
Yes, because labor is always covered for two years
questions.explanation: 두 지문을 연계해야 하는 문제입니다. 기본 인건비 보증은 1년이지만, Mr. Bell은 구매한 주에 제품을 등록했으므로 6개월이 연장되어 총 18개월간 보장됩니다. 구매한 지 14개월이 지났으므로 18개월 이내에 해당하여 인건비가 보장됩니다.

questions.question: What cost will Mr. Bell most likely have to pay?
options: Shipping the blender to a service center
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문에 따르면 배송비는 구매 후 90일까지만 회사가 부담하며 그 이후에는 고객 부담입니다. Mr. Bell은 구매한 지 14개월이 지났으므로 서비스 센터로의 배송비를 본인이 지불해야 합니다. 부품은 2년 보증에 해당하므로 무료입니다. 두 지문을 모두 참고해야 하는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: What is NOT mentioned as something excluded from the warranty?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문에서 보증 제외 사항으로 misuse(오용), unauthorized repairs(무단 수리), commercial use(상업적 사용)가 언급되었습니다. 침수 피해(water damage)는 언급되지 않았으므로 정답입니다.

passage:
Global Logistics Forum — Program Highlights (October 12–13, Hartwell Convention Center)

October 12
9:00 A.M. — Opening Keynote: "Smarter Supply Chains," Dr. Elena Ruiz, Grand Hall
11:00 A.M. — Port Automation Trends, Hall B
2:00 P.M. — Green Shipping Workshop, Hall C

October 13
10:00 A.M. — Customs and Compliance Update, Hall B
2:00 P.M. — Panel: The Future of Freight, Grand Hall

Notes for presenters: All slides must be submitted to the program office by October 1. Presenters must complete an audiovisual check in their assigned room one hour before their session begins.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: program@globallogisticsforum.org
From: Elena Ruiz <e.ruiz@nortransinstitute.org>
Date: September 26
Subject: Travel complication

Dear Program Office,

I have just learned that the only available flight will land at 8:30 on the morning of October 12, which makes the required equipment check before my session impossible. Could a technician instead run the check using my slides without me, or could my talk be moved to a later time? In addition, my research team is finalizing new shipping data that I would like to include. Would it be acceptable to submit my slides on October 5 instead of the announced deadline?

Thank you for your understanding.

Elena Ruiz

questions.question: What is the purpose of Dr. Ruiz's e-mail?
options: To cancel her participation in the forum
To request changes related to her presentation
To volunteer for an additional session
To complain about the convention center
questions.explanation: Dr. Ruiz는 항공편 문제로 장비 점검(AV check)을 대신 진행해 주거나 발표 시간을 옮겨 줄 것, 그리고 슬라이드 제출 기한 연장을 요청하고 있습니다. 즉 발표와 관련된 변경 사항을 요청하는 것이 이메일의 목적입니다.

questions.question: Why is Dr. Ruiz unable to complete the audiovisual check?
options: Her session room has not been assigned
Her flight arrives after the check would need to begin
The Grand Hall will be closed that morning
She has not finished preparing her slides
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 프로그램에 따르면 발표자는 세션 시작 1시간 전에 AV 점검을 해야 하는데, 그녀의 기조연설은 10월 12일 오전 9시이므로 점검은 8시에 시작해야 합니다. 그러나 비행기가 8시 30분에 도착하므로 점검이 불가능합니다.

questions.question: In which room is Dr. Ruiz scheduled to speak?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 이메일 발신자인 Dr. Ruiz는 프로그램표에서 10월 12일 오전 9시 기조연설 'Smarter Supply Chains'의 연사로 명시되어 있으며, 해당 세션 장소는 Grand Hall입니다.

questions.question: By how many days does Dr. Ruiz want to extend the slide deadline?
questions.explanation: 프로그램 공지에 따르면 슬라이드 제출 기한은 10월 1일인데, Dr. Ruiz는 10월 5일에 제출하기를 원합니다. 따라서 4일 연장을 요청하는 것입니다. 두 지문의 날짜 정보를 비교해야 풀 수 있는 연계 문제입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Dr. Ruiz's presentation content?
options: It will include recently gathered data
It was used at a previous forum
It must be approved by Hall B technicians
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'my research team is finalizing new shipping data that I would like to include'라고 했으므로, 그녀의 발표에 최근 수집된 새로운 데이터가 포함될 것임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.question: Which package is Ms. Raman most likely interested in?

questions.question: Will Castellan Inc. be charged the private room fee?

questions.question: What is suggested about the vegetarian meal request?
options: It was submitted too late to be honored
It was made with enough advance notice
It is available only for the Platinum Package

questions.question: What additional information does Ms. Raman ask about?
questions.explanation: 이메일 마지막 부분에서 'whether a microphone and speaker can be provided for short speeches'라고 물었으므로, 연설을 위한 음향 장비 제공 여부를 문의하고 있습니다.

passage:
VoyageSafe Travel Insurance — Summary of Coverage

Trip cancellation: Up to $3,000 reimbursed when supporting documentation is provided.
Baggage delay: If checked baggage is delayed more than 12 hours, essential purchases (clothing and toiletries) are reimbursed up to $200.
Emergency medical expenses: Covered up to $50,000.

All claims must be submitted within 30 days of the policyholder's return date and must include original receipts and any relevant airline documentation. Claims are normally processed within 15 business days of receipt.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: claims@voyagesafe.com
From: Hannah Osei <h.osei@brightmail.com>
Date: June 10
Subject: Baggage delay claim — Policy #VS-88412

Dear Claims Department,

I returned from Lisbon on June 2. On my outbound trip, my checked suitcase was delayed for 18 hours, and I had to purchase toiletries and a change of clothes, spending a total of $185. I have attached the receipts for these purchases along with the delay confirmation letter issued by the airline. Could you confirm that my claim is complete and let me know when I can expect the reimbursement to be processed?

Thank you,
Hannah Osei

questions.question: Is Ms. Osei eligible for baggage delay reimbursement?
options: Yes, because her bag was delayed more than 12 hours
No, because her bag eventually arrived
No, because she filed the claim too late
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 보험 약관상 수하물이 12시간을 초과해 지연되면 보상 대상인데, 이메일에서 그녀의 가방은 18시간 지연되었다고 했으므로 보상 자격이 있습니다.

questions.question: How much will Ms. Osei most likely be reimbursed?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 필수품 구매는 최대 $200까지 보상되는데, 그녀의 지출액은 $185로 한도 이내이므로 전액인 $185를 보상받을 가능성이 큽니다.

questions.question: By what date must Ms. Osei's claim be submitted?
options: Before the end of the calendar year
questions.explanation: 약관에 따르면 모든 청구는 귀국일로부터 30일 이내에 제출해야 합니다. 이메일에서 그녀의 귀국일이 6월 2일이라고 했으므로 6월 2일부터 30일 이내가 제출 기한입니다. 두 지문의 정보를 결합해야 하는 문제입니다.

questions.question: How long does claim processing normally take?
questions.explanation: 첫 번째 지문 마지막 문장에서 'Claims are normally processed within 15 business days of receipt'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.question: What did Ms. Osei include with her e-mail?
options: Receipts and an airline confirmation letter
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'I have attached the receipts for these purchases along with the delay confirmation letter issued by the airline'이라고 했으므로 영수증과 항공사 지연 확인서를 첨부했습니다.

questions.question: What extra payment will Ms. Moran most likely need to make?

questions.question: What information does Ms. Moran request?

questions.question: How much will the audio guides for the students cost in total?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 계산 문제입니다. 오디오 가이드는 1대당 $5이고 학생 24명 전원을 위해 대여하려고 하므로 24 × $5 = $120입니다.

questions.question: According to the Web page, when is museum admission free?
options: On the first Friday of each month
During the last week of an exhibition
questions.explanation: 웹페이지 마지막 문장에서 'Admission is free for all visitors on the first Friday of every month'라고 했으므로 매월 첫째 주 금요일에는 무료입니다.

passage:
Fairway Auto Service — Maintenance Reminder

Dear Vehicle Owner,

Our records show that your sedan is due for its 60,000-kilometer service, which includes an oil and filter change, a complete brake inspection, and a tire rotation. The estimated cost is $180. Book your appointment by April 30 to receive a 10 percent discount on the total. The service takes approximately three hours. Complimentary loaner cars are available for appointments scheduled Monday through Thursday only. Call 555-0184 or reply to this notice by e-mail to schedule.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: service@fairwayauto.com
From: Olga Brennan <o.brennan@mailhub.org>
Date: April 26
Subject: Scheduling my 60,000 km service

Hello,

I received your reminder, and I would like to schedule the recommended service for Friday, May 2, since that is my day off. I will need a loaner car for the day because I have several errands to run while my car is in the shop. Also, since I am booking now, before the end of the month, I assume the discount will still apply even though the appointment itself falls in May — could you confirm that? Please let me know what times are available on that date.

Thank you,
Olga Brennan

questions.question: Will Ms. Brennan most likely receive the 10 percent discount?
options: Yes, because she booked before April 30
Yes, because she is a longtime customer
No, because her appointment is in May
No, because she requested a loaner car
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 안내문에서 4월 30일까지 '예약하면(book by April 30)' 할인을 제공한다고 했고, 그녀는 4월 26일에 예약을 신청했으므로 약속 날짜가 5월이라도 할인을 받을 가능성이 큽니다.

questions.question: What problem does Ms. Brennan's request present?
options: The shop is closed on Fridays
Loaner cars are not offered on Fridays
Her vehicle does not need servicing yet
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 무료 대차(loaner car)는 월요일부터 목요일 예약에만 제공되는데, 그녀는 금요일인 5월 2일에 대차를 요청했으므로 이 요청은 충족되기 어렵습니다.

questions.question: What is NOT included in the 60,000-kilometer service?
questions.explanation: 안내문에서 해당 서비스에는 오일 및 필터 교환, 브레이크 점검, 타이어 위치 교환이 포함된다고 했습니다. 배터리 교체는 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: How long does the service usually take?
questions.explanation: 안내문에서 'The service takes approximately three hours'라고 명시되어 있으므로 약 3시간이 소요됩니다.

questions.question: Why did Ms. Brennan choose May 2 for her appointment?
options: It is the last day of the discount period
It is her day off from work
The shop offered her that date
Loaner cars are available that day
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'Friday, May 2, since that is my day off'라고 했으므로 그날이 그녀의 휴무일이기 때문입니다.

passage:
TaskFlow 4.2 — Release Notes (March 2)

New in this version:
• Calendar synchronization with all major calendar services
• Dark mode for reduced eye strain
• Search results now load up to 50 percent faster

Known issue: Exporting projects that contain more than 150 tasks to PDF may fail. A fix will be included in version 4.2.1, scheduled for release in late March. Please note that the TaskFlow mobile app is updated separately, and some new desktop features may not appear on mobile devices until a later date. For assistance, visit support.taskflow.com.

--- Passage 2 ---

To: feedback@taskflow.com
From: Jonas Lindqvist <j.lindqvist@nordicdesign.se>
Date: March 9
Subject: Feedback on version 4.2

Hello TaskFlow Team,

I upgraded to 4.2 last week, and the dark mode is a wonderful addition — my eyes thank you. However, I have run into a frustrating problem: whenever I try to export my main project, which contains about 200 tasks, to PDF, the export fails every time. Is this being worked on, and when can I expect a solution? On a related note, I noticed that dark mode has not appeared in the mobile app on my phone. Is that expected behavior or a separate bug?

Best regards,
Jonas Lindqvist

questions.question: What is suggested about Mr. Lindqvist's export problem?
options: It is a documented known issue
It was caused by his calendar settings
It has never been reported before
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 릴리스 노트에서 150개 이상의 작업이 포함된 프로젝트를 PDF로 내보낼 때 실패할 수 있다는 알려진 문제(known issue)를 언급했는데, 그의 프로젝트는 약 200개의 작업을 포함하므로 이 알려진 문제에 해당합니다.

questions.question: When can Mr. Lindqvist expect a fix for the export problem?
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 릴리스 노트에서 수정 사항은 3월 말 출시 예정인 4.2.1 버전에 포함될 것이라고 했으므로 3월 말에 해결될 것입니다.

questions.question: Why is dark mode missing from Mr. Lindqvist's phone?
options: His phone is too old to support it
The mobile app is updated separately
Dark mode is a paid feature
He has not restarted the app
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 릴리스 노트에서 모바일 앱은 별도로 업데이트되며 일부 새 데스크톱 기능은 나중에야 모바일에 나타날 수 있다고 했으므로, 이는 버그가 아니라 정상적인 상황입니다.

questions.question: What improvement is mentioned in the release notes?
questions.explanation: 릴리스 노트에서 'Search results now load up to 50 percent faster'라고 했으므로 검색 결과 로딩 속도가 최대 50퍼센트 빨라졌습니다.

questions.question: What feature does Mr. Lindqvist praise?
questions.explanation: 이메일에서 'the dark mode is a wonderful addition — my eyes thank you'라고 했으므로 다크 모드를 칭찬하고 있습니다.

passage:
QUOTATION — Crestline Office Supply
Date issued: June 2 | Quotation #Q-7741 | Prepared for: Halden Associates

12 ErgoFlex desk chairs — $240 each
6 RiseWell standing desks — $410 each
Delivery charge: $120 (waived for orders totaling more than $5,000)
Discount: 5 percent off chair pricing for orders of 10 or more chairs

This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date of issue. To place an order, contact our sales team at sales@crestlineoffice.com.

--- Passage 2 ---

MEMO — Halden Associates

To: Finance Department
From: Veronica Stamos, Operations Director
Date: June 25
Re: Office furniture purchase approval

I am requesting approval to proceed with quotation #Q-7741 from Crestline Office Supply for the new annex workspace. Note that our order is large enough that we will not pay anything for delivery, and the chairs qualify for the volume discount as well. Please process the payment paperwork no later than July 1, since the supplier's pricing is only guaranteed until early next month. Once finance signs off, I will place the order with their sales team the same day so the furniture arrives before our staff move in.

Veronica Stamos

questions.question: Why will Halden Associates not pay a delivery charge?
options: Delivery is always free for memos
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 계산 문제입니다. 의자 12개 × $240 = $2,880, 책상 6개 × $410 = $2,460로 합계 $5,340이며, 견적서에서 $5,000를 초과하는 주문은 배송비 $120가 면제된다고 했으므로 배송비를 내지 않습니다.

questions.question: Why does Ms. Stamos want the paperwork processed by July 1?
options: The quotation expires in early July
The finance department closes for the summer
Prices will drop after that date
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 견적서는 발행일인 6월 2일로부터 30일간 유효하므로 7월 초에 만료됩니다. 따라서 그녀는 가격이 보장되는 기한 안에 결제 처리를 끝내려는 것입니다.

questions.question: Why do the chairs qualify for a discount?
options: More than ten are being ordered
They are being bought with desks
The order was placed in June
questions.explanation: 두 지문 연계 문제입니다. 견적서에서 의자 10개 이상 주문 시 의자 가격의 5퍼센트를 할인한다고 했고, 주문 수량은 12개이므로 할인 대상입니다.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To request approval for a purchase
To complain about a late delivery
questions.explanation: 메모 첫 문장에서 'I am requesting approval to proceed with quotation #Q-7741'이라고 했으므로 구매 승인을 요청하는 것이 목적입니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. Stamos do after receiving approval?
questions.explanation: 메모 마지막 문장에서 'Once finance signs off, I will place the order the same day'라고 했으므로 승인이 나면 당일에 바로 주문할 것입니다.
